description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP wrapper class for integrating CKEditor (version < 5) into PHP applications. It provides methods to create, replace, and configure CKEditor instances, manage event handlers, and generate the necessary JavaScript code for embedding CKEditor into web pages.

classes.name: CKEditor
classes.description: A PHP class that serves as a wrapper for the CKEditor JavaScript library, enabling server-side instantiation and configuration of rich text editor instances.

methods.name: editor
methods.description: Creates a CKEditor instance with specified parameters including name, initial content, configuration, and event handlers.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing textarea element with a CKEditor instance by ID.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all textarea elements in the document, or those with a specific class name, with CKEditor instances.

methods.name: addEventHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler for a specific CKEditor event.

methods.name: clearEventHandlers
methods.description: Clears registered event handlers for CKEditor events.

methods.name: addGlobalEventHandler
methods.description: Registers a global event listener for CKEditor.
